enrichment.headline: Pays Tulum Innovative Engineering $34,800 for an automatic accessible door at Santa Fe Young Adult Program
enrichment.summary: Tulum Innovative Engineering of Oakland will remove the door closure device at the main door to the playground and parking lot and install a door operating system that meets the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) at the Santa Fe Young Adult Program, 915 54th Street. The total is $34,800, paid from Fund 21/Measure J. Work is to start February 29, 2024 and finish by March 31, 2024.
